title: PlanReviewStatus
description: Result of `rebar review-plan <ticket_id> --status --output json` (and the library rebar.llm.plan_review_status() / MCP plan_review_status): the read-only currency verdict for a ticket's plan-review attestation. It runs the EXACT local check the claim gate runs — no LLM and no network — so `ok` is precisely what a `claim` would decide. `verdict` classifies WHY, and `reason` names what changed. `verified_at_sha` is the code anchor the plan was reviewed against (the pinned verified-at-sha for a scoped/attested review, else the signed HEAD for an unscoped/local one) and `signed_at` the sign timestamp; both are null when no readable certified attestation exists.

ok.description: True iff the attestation is current right now — i.e. a claim would pass the plan-review gate. True iff verdict is `certified`.

verdict.description: The compute_validity classifier. `certified` when current; every other value is a non-current reason NAMED by `reason` (which material component, which dependency files, which two SHAs, which reopen). Criteria-registry drift is NOT among them — it is grandfathered (ADR 0053) and surfaces as the non-blocking registry_drift field on compute_validity's result.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation naming what changed (bug 94a3), not a list of what might have.

verified_at_sha.description: The code anchor the plan was reviewed against. Null when no readable certified attestation exists.

signed_at.description: Sign timestamp of the attestation. Null when no readable certified attestation exists.
